findings.assertion: Sload 2020 Table 4.1 reports undisturbed fill: 506 macrobotanical pieces in 168.75 L (3.0/L); undisturbed use: 490 pieces in 105 L (4.67/L). Overall recovery is 1393 pieces and 404.5 L, leaving 397 pieces and 130.75 L outside the undisturbed fill/use subset. These are recovery measurements, not proof of ancient diet or offerings.
findings.locator: Printed p.59 Table 4.1; PDF zero-based page 82; screenshot directly inspected
findings.limitation: Original raw botanical dataset unexamined; Sload's stratigraphic classifications not independently tested.

findings.assertion: University of Pittsburgh 2020 Sun Pyramid cave botanical codebook explicitly exemplifies registro 050500, TE28B West pit layer 1, with one uncarbonized Argemone (Papaveraceae), and registro 050565, TE28D layer 5, with one uncarbonized Oxalis (Oxalidaceae), 10 L soil floated per registro. Codebook examples only, not full specimen dataset; no ancient dietary or ceremonial interpretation warranted.
